meta.counting_convention: One record per lateralised instance where the tables lateralise (right/left as separate records, mirroring the skeletal, muscular, cardiovascular, nervous and respiratory modules); one record for an un-sided class modelled jointly. The nine subtree organs are records keyed on their PART-OF concepts; canal divisions, taeniae, liver lobes/hemilivers/sectors/segments, biliary trees, the pancreatic duct, mouth parts and peritoneal structures are records keyed on PART-OF concepts; the extrahepatic ducts, salivary gland instances, hepatovenous segment ix, the mesentery of the large intestine and the 28 permanent teeth are records keyed on IS-A concepts. Portal and hepatic vessels (cardiovascular), palate muscles and the external anal sphincter (muscular), the jaws (skeletal), structural roots, generic classes, in-vivo region classes, zonal parts, walls, parenchyma, mouth region parts and named biliary tributaries are censused with dispositions, not recorded here.

totalsegmentator_overlap.note: of the 104 TotalSegmentator v1 labels (Milestone 3 census), exactly eight are digestive: esophagus, stomach, duodenum, small bowel, colon, liver, gallbladder and pancreas, each present in all 1,204 subjects. The spleen label is filed under lymphatic in that census and is a cross-reference only. TS v1 has no segment, duct, gland, tooth or peritoneum label, so it adds no coverage below the organ level.
